title: Instagram Reels Hooks
content: Open with a clear promise, use a fast pattern interrupt in the first 2 seconds, and make the viewer feel the result immediately. Examples: '3 things I stopped doing to get clearer skin' or 'The routine that cut my editing time in half.'

title: LinkedIn Posting Cadence
content: Aim for 3 thoughtful posts per week, balancing leadership, trends, and audience education. Keep text tight, use a strong first line, and use engagement-driven questions in the last sentence.

title: Hashtag Research Method
content: Start with 5 niche tags, 5 community tags, and 3 brand tags. Review the top 20 posts in each set, adjust based on what actually attracts the right audience, and avoid repeating generic tags with no relevance.
